company.name: Bharat Electronics
company.tag: Builds radars, communication and electronic warfare equipment mostly for the Indian armed forces
products: Electronic voting machines, airport radars and rail signalling
company.productNote: Products named in Bharat Electronics' 2025–26 integrated annual report. It is a government-owned company that mostly sells to the Indian armed forces. Its joint ventures (with Thales and Israel Aerospace Industries) report separately. Pictures are annual-report photographs; the report does not caption the individual places, and the other six pictures are labelled illustrations. The report has no usable photographs of individual products beyond the naval and missile pictures.
